_doc: Vertical-slice content index for the implementation team (synthesis step, 2026-10-19). Generated from the design docs; where they and this file differ, the design doc named in 'sources' wins and this file is fixed. 'id_status': 'doc' means the id is written in a design doc; 'proposed' means the doc gave none and the id was coined here (snake_case, faction prefix). Numbers are design values, never the reference game's; tools/ip/check_value_echo.py and check_banned_terms.py guard them. Names and ids carry no reference-game terms. Priorities follow slice-plan.md (P0 = the slice is not done without it, P1 = next Higgsfield grant).

kingdom.signature_mechanic_inherited: Levy Horn (worker militia, armed in place near a hall)

units.name: Hodman
